noAccess.title: You don’t have access to transfers
noAccess.body: Seeing transfers needs inventory.stock.view (the warehouse, buying, planning, read-only); changing them needs inventory.transfers.manage (the warehouse). Ask an administrator.

list.intro: Goods moving between your sites, or to another company of the group, with their DDT. Goods in transit stay the sending site’s stock until they are received.
list.noMatchBody: Clear the filters to see every transfer.
list.emptyBody: A transfer moves stock to another site with its DDT.
list.search: Search number, DDT, site, material, lot or hide
list.foot: The tiles count every transfer you can see.
list.footMore: More transfers match than are shown: narrow the filters.

hint.ADJUSTMENT: The missing goods leave the transit location as an adjustment (lost or damaged).
hint.CARRIER_CLAIM: Written off the transit location too; the claim to the carrier is followed apart.
hint.SENT_BACK: The goods never left: the line goes back to the location it was picked from.

refusal.SAME_SITE: A transfer goes to another site.
refusal.NO_TRANSIT_PLACE: The sending site has no transit location: make one under Warehouse › Locations (type Transit).
refusal.NOT_A_TRANSIT_PLACE: The goods travel on a transit location of the sending site.
refusal.PLACE_NOT_USABLE: That location cannot be used here (archived or a transit location).
refusal.NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft changes its lines, ships or is cancelled.
refusal.NOT_IN_TRANSIT: Goods are received while the transfer is in transit.
refusal.NOT_SHIPPED: Nothing of this transfer has left yet.
refusal.TOO_MANY_LINES: A transfer has at most 200 lines.
refusal.NO_PICK_PLACE: Every line needs the location it is picked from.
refusal.NOT_ENOUGH_STOCK: A line takes more than its location holds now.
refusal.LOT_NOT_SENT: A blocked or rejected lot does not travel.
refusal.LOT_REQUIRED: This material is tracked by lot: pick the lot.
refusal.HIDE_REQUIRED: This material is tracked hide by hide: one line per hide.
refusal.HIDE_WHOLE: A hide travels and arrives whole.
refusal.HIDE_ON_ANOTHER_LINE: This hide is already on another transfer that has not left.
refusal.MORE_THAN_IN_TRANSIT: More than is still in transit cannot arrive.
refusal.NO_PUT_PLACE: Pick where the goods are put at the receiving site.
refusal.REASON_UNKNOWN: That reason is not an active Discrepancy reason.
refusal.NOTHING_RECEIVED: Say what arrived on at least one line, or why a line is short.
refusal.NOTHING_TO_SETTLE: Nothing of this line waits to be settled.
refusal.REASON_FIRST: Say the reason for the difference first.
refusal.SENT_BACK_PART: Part of this line arrived: write the rest off or claim it from the carrier.
refusal.NO_DDT_SERIES: The sending company has no single active DDT series: an administrator sets it up under numbering.
refusal.NO_TRANSFER_SERIES: The sending company has no transfer series: an administrator sets it up under numbering.
refusal.NO_LOT_SERIES: The receiving company has no lot series: an administrator sets it up under numbering.
refusal.DDT_NOT_PRINTABLE: The DDT cannot be printed as it stands: complete the companies’ legal data and addresses.
refusal.NO_DDT: No DDT yet: it is issued when the transfer ships.
refusal.NO_RIGHT_FROM: Only the sending site’s warehouse does this (inventory.transfers.manage).
refusal.NO_RIGHT_TO: Only the receiving site’s warehouse does this (inventory.transfers.manage).

problem.invalid: Some fields are not right: see below.
problem.notFound: This transfer does not exist or is in another company.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries: wait a moment.
problem.stale: Someone changed it first: it was read again.
problem.unavailable: The factory cannot be reached now.
problem.writeForbidden: You may not do this here.
problem.contract: This screen is older than the factory: reload the page.

held.expectedBeforeShip: The expected arrival is not before the ship date.
held.expectedPast: The expected arrival is today or later.
held.moreThanInTransit: Line {seq}: more than is in transit.
held.noManage: You don’t have the right to change transfers (inventory.transfers.manage).
held.offline: Offline: wait until the connection is back.
held.pdfMissing: The PDF is not stored yet: print it again.
held.pickFrom: Pick the site it leaves from.
held.pickTo: Pick the site it goes to.
held.pickTransit: Pick the transit location of this route.
held.putPlace: Line {seq}: pick where it is put.
held.quantity: Line {seq}: what arrived is 0 or more.
held.quantityCell: A quantity above 0, at most 4 decimals.
held.scanFirst: Scan or type a hide tag first.
held.trackingUrl: The tracking page is an https address.
held.weight: The gross weight in kg, above 0.

new.title: New transfer
new.intro: Where the goods leave from and where they go. The lines come next, from the sending site’s stock.
new.noSenders: You may not send from any site.
new.interCompany: Another company: {company}. The DDT reason may be a sale (ask the accountant).
new.transitHint: The sending site has several: one per route.
new.transitOne: In transit the goods lie on {place}.
new.fromPlaceHint: Each line can name its own.
new.toPlaceHint: Each line can be put elsewhere when it arrives.
new.transportLater: Our own van or a carrier is chosen when it ships, with the DDT.

record.notFoundTitle: This record does not exist or is in another company
record.notFoundBody: It may have been moved, or you may not see its sites.
record.title: Transfer {number}
record.offline: Offline: what you see is as last read; every change waits.

lines.label: Lines
lines.emptyBody: Add what moves from the sending site’s stock.
lines.readOnly: Shipped: the lines are fixed. What arrived is on the Received tab.
lines.foot: Type a quantity: Enter or leaving the cell saves it. A hide travels whole.

picker.title: Add from the stock of {site}
picker.label: Stock
picker.countMore: The first {count} rows: narrow the search
picker.pickFirst: Pick the rows to add first.
picker.allTaken: All of it is on the lines already.

transit.reasonInter: the reason the accountant says (two companies)
transit.frozen: An issued DDT never changes (DPR 472/1996); its number is never used again.
transit.cancelled: This transfer was cancelled: it never left.
transit.draftBody: The DDT is issued when it ships, with the reason “{reason}”.
transit.numberOnShip: Its number comes from the company’s DDT series and is never reused.
transit.placeHint: The sending site’s: the goods are its stock until received.
transit.draftTracking: Own van or carrier, packages and weight are given when it ships.

ship.title: Ship {number}
ship.never: The DDT number is issued now and never reused; the lines can no longer change.
ship.reasonHint: Between two sites of the same company: a transfer.
ship.reasonInter: Two companies: the reason the accountant says.
ship.donePdfMissing: Shipped with DDT {ddt}; its PDF is not stored yet: print it again.

receive.title: Receive {number}
receive.intro: What arrived at {site}. A short line with its reason closes the transfer; without a reason it waits for the rest.
receive.scanHint_one: {count} hide on its way: scan its tag.
receive.scanHint_other: {count} hides on their way: scan each tag.
receive.nothing: Nothing is still on its way.
receive.reasonWaits: No reason: the rest may still come.
receive.donePart: Received in part: the rest is still on its way.

received.label: Received at destination
received.notShippedBody: What arrives is shown here once it ships.
received.openDifferencesBody: The missing goods are still on {place} until they are settled.

cancel.title: Cancel {number}
cancel.body: A draft that never left is cancelled; it stays in the list.
